messages:
Ari: Quick heads-up 1 - launching Local Audit Bundle Encryption (LABE) + DSR Automation for Private customers as a GA-preview today. This bundles encrypted audit exports with per-tenant wrapping keys and an API to generate DSR packages. Docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-labe-dsr
Ben: Nice. Does this change the audit format or retention windows?
Ari: Format unchanged (jsonl audit bundles), but bundles are now encrypted with tenant-wrapped keys. Retention policy defaults still apply; you can configure retention per-tenant in Console -> Compliance.
Nina: Ops note: to opt-in on a tenant you must enable-local-audit and provide a wrapping_key_id or opt to use Redwood-managed tenant wrapping. Example CLI:
```
redwoodctl private audit enable --tenant acme-int --enable-local-audit true --wrapping-key-id projects/acme/keys/1234
```
Privacy: DSR automation exposes a new endpoint to collect a tenant's PII-scoped artifacts into a single downloadable package. Access requires the tenant_admin scope and emits an audit record. See privacy runbook for export redaction rules.
Ops Oncall: Rolling canaries tonight 23:45 UTC against 8 onprem tenants. Will monitor bundle creation latency and decryption success rate. @eng please watch error budget for key unwrap ops.
deploy-bot: rollout started for onprem-labe-dsr v1.0 -> canary group (8). Status: in-progress. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/logs/rollout/4301230000
Ari: Action items: 1) SEs: flag customers needing assisted migration for historical audit re-encryption. 2) Privacy: review DSR export redaction edge-cases. 3) Eng/Ops: validate metrics (bundle size, creation time, unwrap failures).
Ben: Will schedule customer comms template and include sample DSR package checklist.
Ari: TL;DR: feature available as GA-preview today for Private; opt-in per tenant, no service downtime, encrypts audit bundles and adds DSR automation. Ping here with issues. :shield:
